Fixture Report (sample v2)

A mock-up of the New Fixture Report after the PO review. The table has every column of the Fixture List Export All, limited by the date range you choose, plus a few added columns. Charts and pivots are built by the user from that table, as in the Port Call Evaluation Report. There are no ready-made reports.
